Definition: a ledge or offset in a building
BiblicalUsage: The galleries of the temple were the ledges and passages that ran around the side chambers, and Ezekiel measured them as carefully as the rest of the house. The word appears only in his vision of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the ledges of God's house were measured, because nothing in His dwelling is an afterthought.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
